info.name: NOAA CO-OPS Data Retrieval Benchmarks Datagetter API

params.name: station
params.description: 7-character station ID (e.g., 9414290) or currents station code (e.g., cb1401).

params.name: product
params.description: The type of data product to retrieve.

params.name: begin_date
params.description: Start date for data retrieval. Format: yyyyMMdd or MM/dd/yyyy. Required unless using `date` or `range`.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for data retrieval. Format: yyyyMMdd or MM/dd/yyyy. Required unless using `date` or `range`.

params.name: date
params.description: Quick time reference shorthand. Mutually exclusive with begin_date/end_date/range.

params.name: range
params.description: Hours of data to retrieve from the current time (or from begin_date if supplied). Use `range=1` to `range=48` for sub-daily products; large values for predictions.

params.name: datum
params.description: Vertical datum for water level data. Required for water_level and predictions products.

params.name: interval
params.description: Data interval. Use 'h' for hourly, or integer minutes (1, 6, 15, 30, 60). Applies to water_level and currents.

params.name: bin
params.description: Current depth bin number for ADCP currents data.

params.name: application
params.description: Identifier for the calling application. Helps NOAA track usage.

params.name: expand
params.description: Include additional detail in currents response.

items.docs: Returns tides, water levels, currents, meteorological observations, or predictions from a specified NOAA CO-OPS station for a given time range and product type.
